title: My first game: a village defense game from the Stone Age to the future – art made with Gemini, code with an AI assistant (free, plays on mobile)
author: Commercial_Hand1223
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm a complete beginner and this is my very first game, made with Godot.



You build your village by day and defend it at night. Beat the boss of each age and your whole village transforms: Stone Age → Middle Ages → Modern Age → Future (laser towers and a giant mothership).



How AI was used:

\- All art was generated with Google Gemini, then cut out, adjusted and animated (cut-out animation with a custom figure editor)

\- The code was written together with an AI assistant (Claude)

\- Game design, testing and decisions are my own



It runs in the browser on desktop and on mobile (landscape), free:

[https://tollwutananas.itch.io/eras-of-dawn](https://tollwutananas.itch.io/eras-of-dawn)



I'd love feedback – especially from people playing on their phone: does the touch control feel okay? What was confusing? When did you stop playing?

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: The age jump is the part that makes me curious. When I beat a boss and the village changes, do my building choices carry into the next age? If they do, players can plan for more than one night. If they reset, I would make that very clear before the boss fight.
